What is SciSpace?

All-in-one academic research workspace: an AI copilot that explains papers line by line, a literature review table builder, a paraphraser, an AI detector and a manuscript formatter for 40,000+ journal templates.

Best for

Reading and understanding dense papers, especially for non-native English speakers.

Main features

  • Copilot that explains any highlighted text, equation or figure in a PDF
  • literature review tables with custom columns
  • paper search across 280M+ papers
  • AI writer and paraphraser
  • AI content detector
  • journal template formatter
  • citation generator
  • Deep Review reports.

Practical use cases

  • Understanding a difficult paper section by section
  • building a comparison table across 20 papers
  • formatting a manuscript to a target journal's template
  • paraphrasing and language polishing for non-native writers
  • generating a first-pass literature review.

Who is it for?

  • Graduate students, early-career researchers, non-native English speakers reading English literature, thesis writers.

Pricing, free access & limits

Freemium subscription

Plans described in the source

Free tier with limited monthly messages and uploads. Premium around $12-20/mo billed annually (higher billed monthly). Advanced/Pro tiers around $20-40/mo for higher limits and Deep Review. Team and institutional pricing on request. Verify - SciSpace repackages tiers frequently.

Free plan

Yes - free tier with limited Copilot messages and uploads.

Free trial

Short paid trials offered periodically; free tier is the main evaluation route.

Usage limits to consider

Free tier caps Copilot messages, PDF uploads and literature-table rows per month. Deep Review and high-volume extraction are paid-tier features.

Confirm current plans and pricing ↗

Strengths & tradeoffs

These points summarize the supplied research, rather than hands-on test results.

Strengths noted in the source

  • The explain-this-paragraph Copilot is excellent for hard material
  • multilingual explanation of English papers is a real advantage for non-native speakers
  • journal formatting saves hours
  • very broad feature set for the price.

Limitations to consider

  • Breadth comes at the cost of depth - each feature is weaker than the best-in-class specialist
  • AI-detector accuracy is unreliable and should not be used for academic-integrity decisions
  • paraphrasing raises plagiarism-policy questions
  • tier structure changes often.

Platforms, languages & integrations

Platforms

  • Web, Chrome extension, iOS and Android apps

Languages

  • Copilot explains in 75+ languages including Arabic and French - a genuine differentiator

API access

Limited; contact for institutional access

Integrations and exports

  • Zotero, Mendeley, citation export, Chrome extension over journal sites, Word export

Evaluation notes

Do not rely on the built-in AI detector for any consequential judgement - detectors in general have high false-positive rates on non-native English writing. Use SciSpace for comprehension, Elicit for extraction.
